text: The most famous building in Italy is famous for one reason. They built it on mud.
Construction began in eleven seventy-three. Five years in, the soft clay under the south side started squashing, and the tower began to lean.
The fix? Build the upper floors taller on the low side. So the tower actually curves, like a banana.
By nineteen ninety it leaned five and a half degrees. So they slowly dug soil out from under the high side until it settled back to about four.
